title: Multi-stream role Mirror embeddings
hypothesis: Four causally isolated streams whose token embeddings share a common table plus a rank-1 role-conditioned residual can be represented with lower serialized bytes than independent stream tables while retaining held-out token embeddings and zero cross-stream leakage. Mirror-specific value requires improvement over native rank-1 role-conditioned shared-basis embeddings.
physical_object: Common vocabulary embedding table and one shared role residual atom
mirror_coordinate: One scalar role code per stream selecting a view of the shared residual atom
logical_multiplicity: Four logical streams (user, output, thought, tool) with distinct token embeddings

task.metric: held-out embedding NRMSE, actual serialized inference payload bytes, lookup MAC proxy, cross-stream leakage

development.selection_metric: quality/bytes/leakage; exact native alias seals fresh

controls: Independent full embedding table per stream
Hard-tied shared vocabulary embedding with no role coordinate
Mirror shared-base plus rank-1 residual atom and per-stream scalar code
Native shared-basis rank-1 role-conditioned embedding with same factors/function

storage.authority: Actual serialized complete inference payload bytes
paid_objects: all role residual atoms or independent stream tables

compute: embedding lookup and role reconstruction MAC proxy per query
success_gate: Mirror must achieve held-out NRMSE <=0.02, complete bytes <=60% of independent tables, and cross-stream leakage <=1e-6. Mirror-specific success additionally requires a strict Pareto gain over native rank-1 role-conditioned embeddings.
failure_gate: Quality/leakage/byte gate miss or exact native alias without strict function-level gain; fresh remains sealed after exact alias.
boundaries: Synthetic role-specific embedding reconstruction only; not a multi-stream LLM reproduction
Each stream query is evaluated independently; leakage probe verifies implementation isolation, not learned causal attention
Held-out token IDs are fixed by the seed and excluded from development input samples
Logical stream count is not treated as independent capacity
No hardware latency or trained-model claim

Implementation amendment before any results: corrected lookup indexing for batched stream token IDs. No metrics had been generated; partial initial payloads preserved under source/attempts/initial_lookup_shape_error. Fresh remains sealed.

Probe amendment before rerun: the initial leakage check cumulatively perturbed all streams, including the target stream. Preserve under source/attempts/initial_leakage_probe. Corrected probe independently changes only non-target streams; corrected lookup compute proxy charges reconstruction MACs only (table lookup is not a MAC).
